752.title: V for Vendetta
752.overview: In a world in which Great Britain has become a fascist state, a masked vigilante known only as “V” conducts guerrilla warfare against the oppressive British government. When V rescues a young woman from the secret police, he finds in her an ally with whom he can continue his fight to free the people of Britain.

1264.title: The Wild Soccer Bunch 4
1264.overview: With the victory against "The Beastly Beasts", "The Wild Soccer Bunch" showed it to everyone and then won every single game. Only one victory now separates them from the "Pott", the Freestyle Soccer Cup. For this they have to compete against the "Wolves of Ragnarök". But the wolves are not normal opponents! They have a dark secret - and behind them lurks a power stronger than all of them: the girl Horizon and the "Silver Lights" from the fog...

46448.title: Charleston
46448.overview: Charleston is a 1977 Italian comedy film written and directed by Marcello Fondato. It reprises the style of the film The Sting.

95600.title: Chronicle of Anna Magdalena Bach
95600.overview: The life and music of Johann Sebastian Bach as presented by his wife, Anna.
95600.trailerName: CHRONICLE OF ANNA MAGDALENA BACH Official Trailer

456176.title: A Weapon in My Heart
456176.overview: A detective and his partner track down a call girl with information about a drug cartel. After taking her into custody, they are attacked by cartel members. The detective and the woman manage to escape, but they are soon hounded by a professional hitman hired to eliminate them and recover the heroin stolen by the woman.

650032.title: Вторая Таня
650032.overview: Thirty-five-year-old Tanya is a successful modern resident of St. Petersburg. In the evenings, she attends acting classes, where she is assigned to prepare a monologue based on the Siege diary of a woman also named Tanya. Tanya, in the present, begins to imagine herself in the place of Tanya from the past. The two realities gradually intertwine.

962352.title: Land Uncharted
962352.overview: In the 1930s a trio of adventurers set off to find an uncharted land.
962352.trailerName: Land Uncharted - Official Trailer - Short Sci Fi Adventure Film

995888.title: Az Zeeb
995888.overview: The filmmaker, a Chilean of Jewish and Palestinian descent, discovers Super 8 reels belonging to his father’s family. Between Chile, Israel and Palestine, he reconstructs two trajectories shaped by displacement and exile. A lesson in history in which clarity emerges from political complexity.

1001072.title: The Dog Thief
1001072.overview: Martín is a 13-year-old orphan shoeshine boy from La Paz, Bolivia, who has lived his entire life in the streets with the hope and desire to find his father. Driven by this desire and his imagination, Martin bonds with one of his best clients: Mr. Novoa, a lonely tailor whose only emotional bond is his dog, Astor, a fine German shepherd whom he cares for like a son.

1065968.title: Mother's Kingdom
1065968.overview: DOH Ji-wook is the author of Power of the Truth that gives hope to others, and his mother JOO Kyung-hee, a hairdresser at Kingdom Hair Salon, gives good care to her neighbors. One day, their peaceful kingdom is infiltrated by Kyung-hee's dementia. DOH Joong-myung, a pastor, wants to uncover the truth. In turn, they make different choices to protect their family.

1170608.title: Dune: Part Three
1170608.overview: Emperor Paul Atreides faces the fallout from his ascent to power as political plots and a galaxy-wide holy war endanger the future only he can see.

1212912.title: Cartório das Almas
1212912.overview: Laura, a “young woman” of 126 years old, is the newly hired at Notary of Souls. In her new role, she records the motivations of those who renounced eternity. However, by contract, Laura herself cannot interrupt her tedious existence.

1216624.title: The Depths
1216624.overview: After a brother and sister achieve astral projection, the footage they capture reveals the malicious effects of their family trauma.

1217584.title: Torrente for President
1217584.overview: Years have passed since his last adventure, but José Luis Torrente, the most politically incorrect former cop in Spain, still sees himself as a national hero.
1217584.trailerName: Santiago Segura presenta TORRENTE PRESIDENTE. Solo en cines 13 de marzo.

1218032.title: Super Charlie
1218032.overview: Wille has always dreamed of becoming a superhero and fight crime alongside his father. This dream is shattered when Wille's brother, Charlie, is born. Charlie gets all the attention, and on top of that – he has superpowers. When a supervillain and an evil scientist enact a plan to overthrow the city, Wille and Charlie must put their differences aside and work together as a team. Can an infant and his envious brother save the city?

1241968.title: Manyunya: Childhood of the Ba. In Cinema

1263728.title: 10s Across the Borders
1263728.overview: If the world doesn’t accept you and your kind, trailblaze a world that does. Inspired by the Black and Latinx underground Ballroom culture of New York, Sun, Teddy, and Xyza create Ballroom communities in Southeast Asia as safe havens from homophobia, transphobia, color discrimination and HIV stigma.

1264240.title: Brown Sheep
1264240.overview: 16-year-old Jamila navigates adolescence and natural hair confidence whilst reminiscing her mother; and attending a predominantly white school.

1266800.title: The Desert Child
1266800.overview: 14-year-old Sun has written and successfully published a story based on an incredible story told by her late grandfather about a wild child called Hadara, who is saved by a group of ostriches when he becomes separated from his family in a storm, and is then raised in the desert amid a host of wild animals, including his best friend, a desert fox. When Sun is invited to travel to the Sahara by a local community who has heard about her book, she meets Kharouba, a Nomad girl of her own age, and realizes there may be much more to Hadara than just a character in a bedtime story.

1284016.title: Power Ballad
1284016.overview: When Rick, a past-his-prime wedding singer, meets fading boy-band star Danny during a gig, the two bond over music and a late-night jam session. But when Danny turns one of Rick’s songs into the hit that reignites his career, Rick sets out to reclaim the recognition he believes he deserves - even if it means risking everything he cares about.

1287536.title: Dora and the Search for Sol Dorado
1287536.overview: Dora, Diego, and their new friends trek through the perilous dangers of the Amazonian jungle in search of the ancient and powerful treasure of Sol Dorado to keep it out of enemy hands.

1292784.title: Sumpah Darah
1292784.overview: The story goes that Mara was being courted by a mysterious man named Thomas. Thomas’s promise to give her a beautiful, colorful life ended in a horrific, blood-soaked tragedy for the woman.

1307056.title: Stereo Girls
1307056.overview: 1992, South of France. Charlotte and Liza, both 17, are inseparable. Together, they dream of music and imagine themselves performing on Parisian stages. But a tragedy tears them apart, leaving Charlotte alone, with dreams meant for two.

1317872.title: Sardar 2
1317872.overview: When the mysterious Black Dagger threatens national security, Inspector Vijay embarks on his most dangerous mission yet. As the battle unfolds, the extraordinary origin of legendary spy Sardar is finally revealed, uncovering the sacrifices that forged a legend and the secrets that could shape the future.

1321008.title: Black Box
1321008.overview: A routine domestic flight turns into the flight from hell through a series of inexplicable phenomena and raw terror. Surreal encounters blur the boundaries between reality and nightmare. Passengers fight against all the odds in an attempt to survive while combating bizarre technological malfunctions, accelerating supernatural events and alien influences.

1340208.title: Karoshi
1340208.overview: Described as a corporate thriller with a samurai twist. Set in a Japanese-influenced New York City and features a revenge element. Plot TBA.

1352304.title: Goodbye Cruel World
1352304.overview: Fourteen-year-old Otto writes a suicide letter to his family and classmates, but his attempt fails. Too ashamed to go back home, he hides. As night falls, he roams the city streets like a ghost—until a girl from his high school, Léna, recognizes him.
1352304.trailerName: BIFF2026 Trailer | 굿바이, 이놈의 잔인한 세상 Goodbye Cruel World | 월드 시네마

1358448.title: In Memoriam
1358448.overview: A veteran Hollywood actor becomes obsessed with securing a spot in the Oscars’ “In Memoriam” montage after he receives a terminal cancer diagnosis. This leads to a heartfelt journey of self-exploration as well as ego, humility, and legacy.

1382832.title: Hungry
1382832.overview: A group of holidaymakers must fight for their lives against a rampaging hippo on the loose after becoming lost in the Louisiana swamplands.

1387504.title: The Green Eyes
1387504.overview: Chaya, 11, lives with her family in the Landes region, by the ocean. When they learn they’re being evicted, her older brother Nour falls into a deep and mysterious sleep. Chaya will do everything she can to wake him up, even going so far as to dive into his dreams to find him.

1389232.title: The Mission 2: Free the Hostages
1389232.overview: the secend mission of the group who hacks and steal from rich people for money

1404080.title: The Revisionist
1404080.overview: Elise, a successful novelist, does what so many writers do: she manipulates and transforms the people in her life into the characters she needs for her story. As she blurs the line between fiction and reality, her world descends into secrets, lies, and outright betrayal.

1404400.title: Tell Me Everything
1404400.overview: Amid the late ’80s pop craze and rising HIV epidemic, 12-year-old Boaz uncovers a devastating secret about the father he idolizes that threatens to tear his family apart. Across a yearslong journey, Boaz seeks to heal the wound and reclaim the father-son bond he never stopped yearning for.

1421552.title: Panda Plan: The Magical Tribe
1421552.overview: The panda "Huhu" is about to move into a brand new panda enclosure when he's suddenly confronted by international robbers. Huhu falls off a cliff while battling the robbers, only to awaken to discover he's in a mysterious tribe. To return to the enclosure, this intriguing team helps the tribe solve various problems...

1440304.title: Tough Luck
1440304.overview: ​Arrested by mistake and mistaken for France’s most wanted man, Serge Martin, a peaceful retiree, becomes the target of the media. Caught up in a never-ending whirlwind, he’ll do everything he can to prove his innocence and get his life back… if that’s even possible!

1442608.title: The Waves Will Carry Us
1442608.overview: When Ah Yao returns to Malaysia for his father’s funeral, he expects grief, not chaos. But everything turns upside down when the religious police storm in, claiming his father—who secretly converted to Islam—must be buried in an Islamic cemetery. Refusing to let go, Ah Yao and his siblings set out on a wild, darkly comedic journey to reclaim the body, confronting cultural clashes, family secrets, and absurd obstacles along the way.

1445040.title: Cyberpunk Romance
1445040.overview: The future is here: via so-called ports—USB-like connections on the head—human brains can be directly connected to computers. This enables things like upgrades (foreign languages! expert knowledge!), virtual buzz experiences, and even the networking of multiple brains. A group of neurohackers tries out everything and even develops their own apps. Only Mona is decidedly against this technology; the danger of external control just seems too great.

1448496.title: Ponderosa
1448496.overview: When the buffet where Zeke's mom works closes down, he's forced to entertain the wild advances of a rich regular who is weirdly and vehemently obsessed with becoming his father.

1448944.title: Mundurukuyü – The Forest of the Fish Women
1448944.overview: Using the camera as a weapon to defend their ancestral land in Brazil, three women of the Daje Kapap Eypi audiovisual collective lovingly record their Munduruku traditions and their mythology of humans transforming into forest plants and animals.
1448944.original_title: Mundurukuyü - A Floresta das Mulheres Peixe

1472112.title: Fractured Bonds
1472112.overview: Chaos ensues when 4 siblings reunite for their father’s will reading, creating a rocky divide within the already broken family.

1472304.title: Original Sound
1472304.overview: A down on his luck aspiring musician gets his big break at the big time when an up and coming singer agrees to collaborate with him after she is caught stealing his song.

1475440.title: Beyond Belief
1475440.overview: An aspiring teenage rock star trains for a marathon after hearing a mysterious voice.
1475440.trailerName: BEYOND BELIEF | Official Trailer | Intrigue Films

1477104.title: Shaun the Sheep: The Beast of Mossy Bottom
1477104.overview: On Halloween Eve at Mossy Bottom Farm, excitement turns to dismay when the clumsy Farmer ruins the pumpkin patch. Shaun tries fixing it with science experiments, but things go wrong when a wild beast appears in the woods.
1477104.original_title: Shaun the Sheep: The Beast of Mossy Bottom

1481328.title: Go for Gold
1481328.overview: A Filipina housekeeper starts her first day working for an injured Filipino-Canadian Track Star. In her attempt to connect with him culturally, secrets from his past in the Philippines unravel.

1491248.title: Hotel Excelsior
1491248.overview: A mysterious concierge guides us through stories that unfold in the same room over a century. A Jewish businessman celebrates a lonely family festivity with his daughter. A planned suicide leads to a life-changing encounter. An ageing rock band struggles with their image, and a young woman sees a callboy as her big chance for financial independence.

1506736.title: Thudakkam
1506736.overview: When danger strikes, a young woman fights to survive through courage and determination.
1506736.trailerName: Vismaya Mohanlal’s Thudakkam | Trailer | Aashish Joe Antony | Jude Anthany | Sept 18 | JioHotstar

1507696.title: Apocalypse Z: New World
1507696.overview: The Canary Islands have become Europe’s last refuge following the outbreak of the TSJ virus. When a special mission sets out for the mainland in search of vital supplies, Roberto joins the team with questionable intentions. The dangerous operation turns into a desperate race for survival, and Roberto and his companions find themselves caught between hordes of infected and divided loyalties.
1507696.trailerName: Apocalypse Z: New World - Official Teaser | Prime Video

1511536.title: Foxing: Kitsuné-tsuki
1511536.overview: Shinano is a character designer drifting through a monotonous routine. Her work is absorbed into a commercially driven system, and on social media, she feels no sense of belonging, deepening her loneliness. One day, Koyami—a fox-masked character from her old doodles—appears, followed by other discarded creations, blurring reality and imagination. As she wanders through her own mind, Shinano realizes they are fragments of herself—the shape of her loneliness—and chooses to keep creating while living with it.

1528752.title: Water For The Birds
1528752.overview: A lost backpack sets young Amin on a daring journey, testing the limits of familial love and personal sacrifice.

1540720.title: We Are Metal Dragon
1540720.overview: A rock band in the 80s made a promise to never give up on their dream of becoming the next Iron Maiden. Forty years later, they're still rehearsing in the same garage - and realize that dream will never come true. They decide to go out on one final tour... where everything goes hilariously wrong.
1540720.trailerName: Vi är Metal Dragon (2026) - Exklusiv trailer

1553200.title: Rascal Does Not Dream of a Dear Friend
1553200.overview: Faced with the truth about Miori and Touko Kirishima, Sakuta must make a choice. This will be his final case of Adolescence Syndrome!
1553200.trailerName: Rascal Does Not Dream of a Dear Friend  |  OFFICIAL TRAILER
1553200.original_title: 青春ブタ野郎はディアフレンドの夢を見ない

1554096.title: STRANGE NEIGHBORS
1554096.overview: Between vast industry and hidden gems of untouched nature, STRANGE NEIGHBORS unfolds a wordless cinematic journey that reveals the silent, profound connection binding two seemingly opposite worlds.

1562032.title: Father Joe
1562032.overview: Set in 1990s Manhattan, the film will see Sutherland play a priest who declares a one-man war on the city’s criminal underworld. Pacino steps into the role of a powerful mob boss whose empire collides with Father Joe’s violent crusade, while Anderson plays a young woman caught between danger and redemption under the priest’s protection.

1563760.title: How We Stand
1563760.overview: Tombs weaves together the triangular story points of three Oklahoma sisters and their mother who travel to Los Angeles as a part of a relocation program in the 1950s that gave Native Americans the opportunity to become “civilized” by getting jobs in urban centres. When they arrive, they begin to understand that like many east-to-west dreams, the reality is not the new beginning they sought. Abandoned by government policy and in acute poverty, they begin to search for their own, finding home in “the tombs” – the cemented riverways of LA. It is here a young mother is killed, and the lives of her children separate down three very different paths that emerge in 1970s Los Angeles – weaving together one telling, one flood.

1572400.title: Shiver
1572400.overview: A ne'er-do-well smuggler finds himself in the middle of a deadly double-cross while on a job in the Caribbean Sea, resulting in him getting surrounded by bodies, hostile mercenaries and thirsty sharks alike, all while stuck in a deathly time loop and scrambling to break the cycle.

1575408.title: Badinter
1575408.overview: Biopic about the famous French lawyer and politician, Robert Badinter.

1588208.title: Bo-bo
1588208.overview: Nadya was born with a pathology. She has a large red-burgundy hemangioma on her small face. In the native village Nadya faces the hostility and ridicule of others, furthermore her own family does not accept the girl as she is. Nadya grandmother tries to treat her illness with all religious methods she knows, while Nadya mother constantly dreams of a surgical operation in Moscow. Nadya just wants to be herself. Her only wish is to sing in the choir. After getting into another mess, she ends up in a Moscow hospital, where meets people like her. But even after the physical problem has been resolved nothing changes in her family life.

1591536.title: Tumbleweed
1591536.overview: Amidst fields of Arabica beans, Hurle, a young woman, dreams of a future beyond the coffee shop where she works to support her mother. Her life is disrupted when she goes in pursuit of an eccentric petty thief who will turn her daily life upside down.

1596336.title: Aanikoobijigan [ancestor/great-grandparent/great-grandchild]
1596336.overview: Trapped in museum archives, Ancestors bend time and space to find their way home. History, spirituality, and the law collide as tribal repatriation specialists fight to return and rebury Indigenous human remains, offering a revealing look at the still-pervasive worldviews that justified collecting them in the first place.

1600560.title: WOLFGANG
1600560.overview: In 1778, a young Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart was in exile in Paris: reeling from his mother’s death, he spent his days writing scatalogical music and drowning in libertine excess. In this genre-defying ‘audiovisual opera’, Mozart’s life becomes a portal into that of Wolfgang, an Iranian artist navigating similar extremes as he too is exiled in Paris: the city where everyone says his dreams will come true, and praises him for escaping the censorship of his homeland.

1605744.title: crow.mp4
1605744.overview: A camera was found at the scene where multiple people have vanished, the footage stirs rumors about local legend Mr. Crowe.

1607600.title: Street Kingdom: Make your own sound.
1607600.trailerName: 2026.3.27公開　映画『ストリート・キングダム 自分の音を鳴らせ。』特報

1608560.title: Dirty Angel
1608560.overview: A young woman gets involved in a typhoon of temptation, pressure, buried secrets and dangerous individuals that prowl the nocturnal streets and has to use her internal strength to create a new balance in her shattered life and start living to the fullest once again.

1618864.title: Sexo e Destino
1618864.overview: Between two families marked by betrayal and obsession—the Nogueiras and the Torres—forces from the spiritual realm work to lead each character to a reckoning with their own destiny.

1620080.title: Less of a Stranger
1620080.overview: A film inspired by the life of Polish rock legend Jan Borysewicz. A story of music, rebellion, and freedom in a world where dreams often collide with a grim reality.

1620272.title: Don't Breathe a Word
1620272.overview: Meredith runs a Lamaze business and hires Eve, who becomes her best friend. When Eve is stalked, Meredith is determined to help. As she investigates, Meredith discovers Eve might be hiding a dark secret.

1621552.title: Facing El Chapo
1621552.overview: Two Mexican officers must survive the final hours of their shift after crossing a ruthless cartel boss.
1621552.trailerName: FACING EL CHAPO Official Trailer (2026) Netflix | Alfonso Herrera, Noé Hernández 🚨

1626544.title: RED VELVET
1626544.overview: Seven criminal's are sent out to retrieve multiple item's for their employer as they uncover the true meaning of their missions.

1627696.title: "It's Murder!"
1627696.overview: Officer Wray is determined to prove to his boss that he has what it takes to bring justice for an innocent victim involved in a murder case gone wrong. His boss assigns him onto a recent murder case involving 7 suspects who all had the potential to have committed this murder. As Officer Wray digs deeper into this mystery, with the help of a key witness and a helpful journalist, the situation becomes more and more dangerous for not just himself, but for everyone involved...

1627824.title: Rocky's Cat-astrophe
1627824.overview: When one of Humdinger's schemes goes awry, a Junkyard Kitten's home is destroyed and Rocky bites off more than he can chew when he invites the kitten to stay at the Lookout overnight. While the kitten causes more trouble than expected, Rocky learns that even heroes need help.

1628720.title: Little Tragedies
1628720.overview: In 2011, Daniel Nolasco moved from his small hometown in the Brazilian countryside to Rio de Janeiro. He went to college. He was the first of a group of queer friends to leave the city. Ten years later, none of the people who made up that group live there anymore; some have died, and those who are alive have moved away. The city is called Catalão, a place that everyone says is too good to live in.

1629360.title: First They Came for My College
1629360.overview: When the Governor of Florida transforms a beloved public honors college in a political coup, students and professors confront a new reality: their campus is ground zero in a growing nation-wide assault on academic freedom.
1629360.original_title: First They Came for My College

1631856.title: Oh Butterfly!
1631856.overview: When a series of unfortunate coincidences involving a woman, her husband and her ex, culminates in a shocking death, her long-lost sister returns to redeem her.

1633264.title: Louis Theroux: Inside the Manosphere
1633264.overview: With rare access and no holds barred, the acclaimed documentarian investigates a growing ultra-masculine network and its controversial influencers.

1633840.title: Mallorca Confidential
1633840.overview: Mallorca, 2007: Chusa is the powerful, self-made matriarch of Son Canal, the epicenter of drug trafficking on the island. A real estate development project threatens her power and her empire. Her niece, Nela, freshly released from prison, discovers a dark secret about Chusa that puts her loyalty at risk. As violence escalates, Nela has only two options: loyalty or freedom.

1634352.title: The Next Day
1634352.overview: During a birthday weekend at a summer house, a group of longtime friends gather to celebrate, laugh, and relive old memories. As the night unfolds, an unexpected moment shifts the emotional balance of the group, leaving one of them silently confronting an experience he does not fully understand.

1634864.title: Carlo Acutis: The Millennial Saint
1634864.overview: The documentary unfolds as a journey through the life of Carlo Acutis – from pilgrimages to Assisi to digital communities around the world, up to his canonisation – illustrating the constant dialogue between earthly life and transcendent reality. It shows how the message of "the first saint of the digital age" can transcend religious boundaries and speak to different generations and distant cultures, reaching from his parish in Milan to Cascia, La Verna, Lanciano, Fátima, Rome and many countries around the world, where his words have resonated and been embraced.

1635312.title: Red Flag Bhalobasha Beshi
1635312.overview: Dibyojyoti Dutta stars opposite Divyani Mondal.

1636272.title: Blank Slate
1636272.overview: Claiming to remember every moment of her life, a woman spirals between past and present during an interview with her local news, revealing the hidden cost of a life she can never leave behind.

1639600.title: Quem Tem com Que Me Pague, Não Me Deve Nada

1640304.title: Pizzopath
1640304.overview: A group of friends are having a party in a villa filled with dancing, alcohol, and laughter. By chance, they find a pizza box in perfect condition and eat it, unaware that it belongs to PIZZOPATH, who will do anything to get back what they've stolen...

1642672.title: Fiction's Hands
1642672.overview: In a tall, abandoned, and oppressive house, Luz pursues Mira, her childhood friend who takes refuge in the darkness, terrified of being seen. Amidst labyrinths of books and interwoven memories, their reunion clashes with reality. Argentine psychological and surreal horror about destructive love and the cost of vulnerability in fiction.

1644912.title: Jimmy O. Yang Finally Home
1644912.overview: From stand-up stages to the big screen, from global fame to “Finally Home,” Jimmy is back! Packed with rapid-fire punchlines and iconic one-liners, this time you don’t need to fight for concert seats—just step into the cinema and laugh out loud together.
1644912.trailerName: Jimmy O. Yang | Finally Home Trailer | In Cinemas March 20

1654448.title: Amityville Toothache
1654448.overview: Gabriel has an excruciating toothache. Unfortunately, his dentist is operating with tools supplied from the cursed town of Amityville.

1654512.title: In The Devil's Den
1654512.overview: Five years after a viral apocalypse leaves the world ruled by worshipped horrors, three brothers hiding in a secluded Louisiana cabin are forced to confront the outside world when a stranger arrives at their door.
1654512.trailerName: In The Devil's Den - Official Teaser

1655728.title: Pfoten vom Tisch
1655728.overview: Film based on the sucessful children's book.

1658096.title: Scuz
1658096.overview: 'Scuz' tells the story of County Cricketer Graham 'Scuzzer' Kersey, who’s life was cut short in a car accident in Australia on Christmas Eve, 1996. With a host of archive clips, unearthed photographs and new interviews with cricketing greats, 'Scuz' explores the memories and wild anecdotes of his career, from his beginnings at Bexley, through to his wicketkeeping years at Kent and Surrey, in a life cut short, but always lived to the full.

1659696.title: Eiga Kamen Raidā Zettsu Sayonara no Misshon
1659696.overview: Baku Yorozu/Kamen Rider ZEZTZ is accused of terrorism by the National Public Safety Commission. Convinced of his innocence, Kensei Odaka/Kamen Rider NOX pursues the true culprit, and finally tracks down the mastermind behind it all, National Public Safety Commission Chairman, Shuma Kumon/Kamen Rider Mugen.
1659696.trailerName: 【最終映画告知】映画『仮面ライダーゼッツ さよならのミッション』

1662256.title: Brave Without Boundaries
1662256.overview: Based on the true story of Luo Shengjiao — one of “100 Touching Chinese Figures” since the founding of the PRC. During the Korean War, Luo, a company clerk, and his fellow volunteers fought fierce battles, endured extreme shortages, and braved brutal cold.

1665392.title: Batik, Beats & Bumbu
1665392.overview: A film about third-generation artists with Indonesian roots who embrace their cultural heritage in their work.  Director Claire Pijman portrays Nusantara Beat, the popular band that sings in Bahasa Indonesia and Sundanese. Vanja van der Leeden, a culinary artist who looks beyond the ‘rijsttafel’. Myrthe Groot & Romee Mulder of fashion atelier Guave, who design clothing made from batik. And Sekan, DJ / photographer / founder of record label Jiwa2, who is putting Indonesian pop music from the ’70s and ’80s back on the map. All artists collaborate with artists from Indonesia, allowing the viewer to also be taken into present-day Indonesia.

1666544.title: Without a Trace
1666544.overview: A criminal on the run attempts to break into a house for hiding. He realizes his escape will be far more difficult than originally planned.

1666608.title: Strive
1666608.overview: In the far flung future, several humanoid creatures live in a city constructed from the remenants of civilizations of generations past. However, plagued by internal struggles and fears, a group of them decides to leave the mortal world behind and venture out into a mystical underworld only spoken about in hushed whispers, belieiving that it might geniunely be the source of their salvation.

1666864.title: Rehearsals for a Revolution
1666864.overview: Through five portraits of relatives and mentors, five expressions of resistance, Pegah Ahangarani sketches her life story. Drawing from personal archives, home videos, street protests footage, newspapers, and recorded voices, she retraces more than 40 years of Iran’s history. From the early days of 1979, until the war that began in 2026, she pieces together intimate and collective memories, forming the portrait of a country shaped by political repression and in constant hope for a revolution.
1666864.trailerName: REHEARSALS FOR A REVOLUTION | Directed by Pegah Ahangarani | Official US Trailer (2026)

1669872.title: Un castello
1669872.overview: Martin is a boy who lives a tormented love for Karin, a girl who instead seems to want nothing more than to escape from him, until she gets sick and remains under the boy's care.

1672944.title: A PINT OF BITTER.
1672944.overview: You are trying to enjoy a quiet pint in the pub but a patron and his son seemingly have a problem with your demeanour ...

1673392.title: The Selling Stage
1673392.overview: At the end of a twenty-five-year career, LuFisto confronts the cost of chasing a dream that asked for everything and gave back less than promised.

1677616.title: Heathen
1677616.overview: A young priest's faith is tested when his mentor returns from a mystical encounter.

1677744.title: Windstärke 17
1677744.overview: After her alcoholic mother’s suicide, Ida - traumatized and plagued by guilt - flees her hometown and ends up on the island of Rügen. There, she begins an intense healing process marked by a fresh start, an unexpected friendship, and her first great love.

1679216.title: the tie around our fingers
1679216.overview: After breaking a blood pact, Iris feels the consequences of that decision in her own body and realizes that certain ties do not disappear when a relationship ends.

1679536.title: The Aura
1679536.overview: Claudia is an unlucky and fatalistic young woman. During an esoteric event in a bookstore, a disturbing apparition in an aura photo will turn her day and her friend Antonia’s upside down.

1681456.title: Raidinalha
1681456.overview: In a human-emptied reality, Raidinalha lives surrounded by frogs and electronic devices. Longing and isolation shape her days. This downward spiral culminates when she slips into a pixel, compelled to rediscover her own sense of touch.

1684016.title: Katy Perry: The Lifetimes Tour – Live from Paris
1684016.overview: Capturing Katy Perry’s electrifying, immersive concert experience, Katy Perry: The Lifetimes Tour – Live from Paris blends powerhouse performances, exhilarating cinematography, and intimate moments to bring audiences into the spectacular world of this creative artist.
1684016.trailerName: Katy Perry: The Lifetimes Tour - Live from Paris Official Trailer
1684016.original_title: Katy Perry: The Lifetimes Tour – Live from Paris

1688368.title: American Prometheus
1688368.overview: A look into the eyes of the man who changed the world. This is the pain of the "American Prometheus" a man haunted by his own creation.

1691120.title: England's Next Top Prince Consort
1691120.overview: England’s Next Top Prince Consort turns Elizabethan politics into a chaotic reality competition as Queen Elizabeth I momentarily abandons statecraft to evaluate a lineup of suitors—Philip II of Spain, the Duke of Anjou, Charles II of Austria, and the ever-intrusive Robert Dudley—under the dubious guidance of judges Walsingham, Cecil, Dudley, and a confused Shakespeare. Confessionals function as court intrigue, alliances form and implode, and a cryptic lady-in-waiting named Balthazar quietly tracks every secret. Assassination rumors, theatrical entrances, and relentless scheming pile up as each contender fights for the queen’s hand and the power attached to it.

1692272.title: PLAVE Asia Tour [DASH: Quantum Leap] Encore in Cinemas
1692272.overview: PLAVE, the group that has now become legendary, brings you an intense performance that only they can deliver. The historic moment when the first virtual idol group entered the Gocheok Sky Dome — the overwhelming energy of [DASH: Quantum Leap] Encore, a night filled with shared emotion, now unfolds on the big screen! From “Dash,” the anthem that signaled the start of a new generation, to the heartfelt fan songs dedicated solely to PLLI, relive the dreamlike moments achieved together in theaters once more.

1693232.title: ترايثليت
1693232.overview: A triathlete living and training in Al-Naseem district, exploring how the sport becomes more than just competition, but a way of life built on discipline, endurance, and commitment. Through his daily routine and personal journey, the film highlights the challenges of pursuing an intense sport while balancing everyday life, offering a closer look at ambition and perseverance within an unexpected environment.

1695088.title: Good Omens: The Finale
1695088.overview: Aziraphale, now Supreme Archangel, seeks Crowley's help as plans for the Second Coming take a surprising yet dangerous turn. Can angel and demon reconcile and forget their differences before it's too late?

1695344.title: Anjali
1695344.overview: A man's emotional & psychological breakdown caused by a toxic relationship descends into chaos, panic, and mayhem when every attempt to end it fails.

1695792.title: L(')A NORMALE
1695792.overview: After being hit by a car, Marc and Maïa, two strangers, find themselves in a place between life and death, where they talk and confront their friendship problems without knowing whether they will survive or not...

1699632.title: Kamala Miss
1699632.overview: Dhurba returns to Kathmandu in search of his former teacher, only to uncover a mysterious connection between his own past and a novel being written about her, blurring the lines between memory, fiction, and reality.
1699632.trailerName: KAMALA MISS || Movie Official Trailer 2026 || Nir Shah, Ramesh Budhathoki, Basana Timilsina

1700464.title: Salitre no more
1700464.overview: For around fifteen years, I have been filming a forest of imburana de cambão trees that has been progressively disappearing, located on the border between the states of Bahia and Pernambuco. The visual saturation created through image overlaps and the division of the screen into three parts fosters the emergence of a particular rhythm, in which pulsating texts impose other forms of escape.The gradual disappearance of this forest echoes texts evoking the consequences of climate change, while also inscribing fire and logging as human acts contributing to this impoverishment.The basis of this film was the installation of the same name presented as part of an exhibition at the Frans Krajcberg Space in 2025. The film is denser. The imburanas de cambão burst into flames as the sertão turns into desert.

1700656.title: Desecration
1700656.overview: Desecration follows detective Sadie Landry in her latest case of investigating a misogynistic religious cult in Dawm Acres, Alabama. It should’ve been a simple case like all her others, however after uncovering the cult’s dangerous secrets, her life is put in danger.

1700976.title: The Cutting Room
1700976.overview: A film student attempts to cut corners the night before an assignment is due.

1702960.title: GOAT Pandemonium Ge on all tempo
1702960.overview: After his hit show "GOAT," Ge Pamungkas is back with fresh material — exploring love, marriage and the battle of the sexes in this comedy special.

1705136.title: Ruins
1705136.overview: Restoring a monument made by her father, a filmmaker retraces how an artwork can be a vessel for mourning and remembrance.

1705584.title: Anatomia do Caos
1705584.overview: With unprecedented access to the Brazilian Senate, director Dandara Ferreira follows the entire trajectory of the Covid-19 Parliamentary Inquiry from the inside, transforming this exclusive footage into a cinematic record of one of the most defining moments of the pandemic in Brazil.

1705776.title: Romin
1705776.overview: When Romin discovers a lost object in the forest, he asks his friends to help him uncover the legend behind this mysterious object, while a grieving man seeks to use the artifact to bring his wife back.

1708592.title: Chants fantômes
1708592.overview: This film-poem is composed of visual and sonic fragments in which landscapes, everyday gestures and distorted songs weave an inventory of loss. Between silence and vertigo, the past resurfaces. Pain, resistance and beauty persist within the absences carved out by colonialism.

1708784.title: FIELDS OF THE SILENCE
1708784.overview: Joel Tuinstra's next film for the 2027 HOCO film fest

1710000.title: Sagrada Familia, le rêve achevé de Gaudi

1710768.title: About
1710768.overview: Everyone wants to make a movie, but about what?

1710896.title: Images of Fire
1710896.overview: A couple’s conversation unravels a film shaped by memory, where images and sounds reconstruct a past marked by state violence.

1711216.title: Psyche
1711216.overview: In-young (18), who suffers from a congenital respiratory disease, is haunted by nightmares following her mother"s death. To cope with the pain, she steals other people"s belongings, eventually ending up in a juvenile detention center.  After her release, In-young transfers to a school in the countryside and moves in with her aunt. There, she meets Eun-ha (18) and feels a subtle, magnetic attraction toward her.

1714224.title: Fractured 3
1714224.overview: When Red and Chloe alter the past to save their families, they return to a fractured present where they are suddenly parents to teenage daughters, their oldest allies have become vicious enemies, and a stolen temporal pocket watch threatens to wipe Wonderland off the map forever.

1718000.title: The Circle
1718000.overview: New Year's Eve, 1999. A man is fatally shot during a hunting trip. Agachi, a young investigator just starting his career, is sent from the capital to determine whether it was a crime or an accident. Soon, this seemingly simple case will turn into a test of conscience.

1718576.title: Branches of a Fig Tree
1718576.overview: In a peaceful world recovering from catastrophe, a spirited runaway meets a magnetic community leader. As they fall in love, they discover truths about connection, the world, and their pasts- and realise they might be more connected than they thought.
1718576.trailerName: Branches of a Fig Tree - Teaser

1719152.title: Double meurtre pour la danseuse
1719152.overview: Student film using film noir codes.

1719792.title: "Feut"
1719792.overview: During a fraternity initiation, a young pledge is forced to endure a series of increasingly disturbing challenges. As tensions rise and the rituals grow more extreme, he begins to question how far he is willing to go to earn his place.

1720240.title: Sathyathil Sambhavichathu
1720240.overview: A long-standing legend speaks of treasure hidden beneath village ponds and wells, with only one man ever claiming to have found it. When clues about the lost treasure begin to surface, a series of misunderstandings, unexpected discoveries, and amusing consequences unfold, blending mystery with humor.
1720240.trailerName: Official Trailer | Sathyathil Sambhavichathu | Prasanth Mohan |Akash Menon |Dilshana | Movie Trailer

1721904.title: Intralight
1721904.overview: INTRALUZ follows Ella, a woman caught between memories and symbols that come to life, reminding her of past moments and unresolved emotions. Through poetic encounters and elements of magical realism, Ella journeys through her inner world, confronting fears, desires, and doubts. This voyage allows her to reconcile with herself and accept who she truly is, discovering the freedom that emerges when one dares to look within.

1722608.title: Farm of the Father
1722608.overview: Dorotea is a young farmer who lives in the family's farm with her father. But, the Father reveals himself to be increasingly obsessive. Stranger and more disturbing events keep happening, and Dorotea just wants to run away.
cast: Giovanni Amendola Provenzano Andrea Orso Valerio

1723888.title: Stranger Things Have Happened to Me
1723888.overview: Antonio is jealous of his new teammate, Stephon, who has kindled a connection with his girlfriend Mya. His anger fuels the fire that stirs up hidden truths and unravels a long list of lies and deception causing chaos around the college campus.

1725104.title: Mystery Science Theater 3000: The RiffTrax Experiments — Sting of Death
1725104.overview: The storied history of Mystery Science Theater includes many, MANY cheap rubber monster suits... and somehow, some way, Sting of Death may have the worst so far. MSTies might recognize director William Grefé as the director behind the MST3K Season 2 experiment Wild Rebels. You'll be happy to know he made Sting of Death first, so Wild Rebels was a movie he made as an even more experienced filmmaker. As an added bonus, this movie also features the aptly titled "Do The Jellyfish" by Songwriting Hall of Fame inductee Neil Sedaka. Does this tune warrant TWO extended dance sequences? Probably not, but it is an earworm that will still be drilled into your head long after the credits roll.
1725104.trailerName: MST3K: The RiffTrax Experiments Official Trailer!

1727088.title: Tunnels of Light
1727088.overview: Abtract forms play with sync, anticipation, pattern, and palette in this theme and variations exploration of sound and performance. Animated semi-improvisationally to a beautiful Gamelan piece by Bill Brennan and Andy McNeill.

1727152.title: My Joint with John
1727152.overview: A once-hopeful screenwriter on the brink of burnout shares one last joint with his stoner best friend.

1727408.title: THE MIND
1727408.overview: Shine, a 20-year-old, frequently experienced violence within her family, leaving her unable to escape the shadow of that past.

1729264.title: Silence
1729264.overview: After his stand-up routine goes awry, Luka goes to drink his sorrows away in a bar. There he meets a mysterious woman in a bar, with the two immediately hitting it off and deciding to go to the former's apartment together. However, as the night goes on, what was supposed to be a one time hook-up leads to the two discovering much more about themselves and they form a powerful spiritual connection.

1729328.title: DON'DUT
1729328.overview: Aflah and his team began working on a personal documentary about Aflah challenging himself to lose weight. But as time went on, his goals began to crumble, his diet slowly lost focus, while Aflah’s desire to control the direction of the film only grew stronger. His team began to question whether this documentary was truly about change, or simply about Aflah wanting to make himself the center of the story.

1730096.title: The Eater
1730096.overview: Douglas' profoundly normal life is thrown into chaos when something starts rearranging his furniture.

1730160.title: Throwback
1730160.overview: A woman reflects on her past while coming to terms with her life through the reflection of her younger self.

1731504.title: How FIFA Chooses the World Cup Final Referee
1731504.overview: See how the process works and who Jonas Eriksson thinks will get the chance to referee the 2026 World Cup final.

1734448.title: Bird on Elephant’s Path
1734448.overview: An unusual day in the life of two men dressed as mascots - one a bird, the other an elephant.

1735024.title: The Hollywood Blacklist: The Survivors Tell Their Stories
1735024.overview: Featuring previously unseen footage from an early-1980s Los Angeles party honouring the blacklistees. (Note: this is an expanded version of footage previously used in "La dernière fête des blacklistés", 2025)

1736496.title: I Matter
1736496.overview: As she stands on the verge of leaving the orphanage she called home, Rebeca, a young Roma girl, clings to the hope that her father's release from prison will finally give her the family she has always longed for. When she is accepted into university to study acting, life finally seems to be opening up for her. But just as Rebeca begins to find her place in this new world, the life she comes from starts to catch up with her, forcing her to make choices she can no longer postpone.

1737648.title: Atopia
1737648.overview: The film explores the state of ‘atopia’ that afflicts Socrates in Plato’s *Symposium*. It is an aesthetic experience of stepping outside oneself, which the work conveys by depicting a musical improvisation by cellist Giovanni Sollima as he plays against a backdrop of abstract images created by directly manipulating 35mm film using acid etching, colour, scratches and abrasions. The secret relationship between the musician and his instrument is thus transposed onto the film medium, producing a synaesthetic perception.

1738288.title: Her Baby Didn't Block Her Jump Shot
1738288.overview: In 1969, high school freshman Jane led her basketball team to a state tournament. In 1970, she scored over 40 points a game. In 1971, when she gives birth, state rules make her ineligible to play. In 1972, with the backing of her coach and friends, she continued to play and began a landmark challenge to a rule that allowed boys involved in a pregnancy to continue playing while refusing the same privilege to girls.

1739312.title: Warga Rusun 609
1739312.overview: The idiosyncratic tenants of a public housing complex must form a unified front to resist an aggressive municipal demolition plan, all while covertly managing a severe supernatural haunting inside Room 609 by an aggrieved spirit demanding an unfulfilled romantic vow.

1739632.title: Jurassic Sharks
1739632.overview: The special takes viewers deep into prehistoric waters to explore the ancient ancestors of today's sharks. Using animation, the episode highlights some of the most feared prehistoric ocean creatures, including the Dunkleosteus, the buzzsaw shark (Helicoprion), and the scissor-toothed shark (Edestus).

1742064.title: The Keep: Molasar´s Return
1742064.overview: A group of explorers goes to the fortress to study it, but when one of them tries to steal one of the crosses, ignoring the warnings of the village priest, Molasar is released once more, bringing chaos and death with him. Now, they will have to fight to survive the fortress's curse.

1742256.title: The Forbidden Aunt
1742256.overview: An actress documents her enigmatic Serbian aunt's story, revealing family secrets and personal history in a dark comedy exploring female trauma across generations.

1742704.title: UVĬDUS
1742704.overview: A humid world of green, rot, stagnant water, and slow decay.

1743600.title: Body and Mind
1743600.overview: Unable to accept her lover's suicide, a woman refuses to believe he is gone. She dismembers his body and insists he was murdered. Yet the world remains haunted by his presence. As she forms a strange communion with his scattered body, fragments of their shared past resurface. Reality, memory, and dreams gradually dissolve into one another, blurring the boundaries between grief and truth.

1744368.title: Bloodline
1744368.overview: Set against the systemic oppression of Chinese American communities, this elegant, spine-chilling drama follows two siblings in 1952 Utah as they search for their family's hidden treasure.

1744880.title: Monstrous Me
1744880.overview: When Ariel was a disabled and disfigured child of three years old, a bad babysitter brought over a bag of weed, her boyfriend, and a VHS of A Nightmare on Elm Street. From under the coffee table, through the railings, Ariel saw themselves in that Zenith television, in the face of Freddy Krueger, and decided there was agency in being a monster rather than a martyr.

1745200.title: Taipei Cat Dreams of Sicily
1745200.overview: A cat’s rumination on other cats, other places.

1745264.title: Тихий свет
1745264.overview: Sister and brother meet at their parents' old dacha after many years of mutual silence.

1745648.title: The Wandering Creature (And Other Tales)
1745648.overview: Writer/director Christopher R. Mihm takes a stab (pun intended) at an anthology movie in the vein of "Twilight Zone: The Movie," "Trilogy of Terror," and "Creepshow," albeit in his signature retro-B-movie style! In a series of linked, short tales-of-horror, an unmanned spacecraft returning from the asteroid Vesta breaks up upon re-entry into the Earth's atmosphere and scatters sample containers across Phantom Lake County! Not-so-unexpectedly, contact with the mysterious, otherworldly contents of these canisters creates a whole host of terrifying creatures—like mushroom monsters, killer garden gnomes, and more!

1745904.title: Catching Rat
1745904.overview: ₩50,000 per rat. Alone on a night shift, Joohyeong puts his finger on the line.

1747056.title: Satuko
1747056.overview: Porfirio Quispe Huillca embarks on a journey in search of the memory of his grandfather, Saturnino Huillca (Satuko), a Quechua-speaking peasant leader who fought for decades for the right to land and for the dignity of Andean communities in times of hacienda, exploitation and abuses.

1747888.title: Inferno
1747888.overview: Twenty years after a mysterious energy-gathering event, Dante remains haunted by what he witnessed that night. Withdrawn and unstable, he can no longer distinguish memory from hallucination. As his children investigate the tragedy that fractured their family, they uncover a past shaped by suppressed memories, guilt, and unresolved consequences. Meanwhile, Dante is pursued by Virgil, a spectral presence who acts as both guide and tormentor. Through a series of psychological trials, Virgil forces him to confront his distorted recollections, moral failures, and the truth of what happened in 2022. As past and present collide, Dante and his children must face their conflicting versions of the truth—and discover whether understanding it will bring forgiveness and redemption or cost them their sanity.

1750768.title: The Clinic
1750768.overview: The Clinic is a documentary exploring the emotional realities of veterinary work through the perspectives of vets, vet nurses and vet techs. Following the care of Katy, a cat brought to the clinic by a rescue agency, the film looks at the compassion, connection and emotional strain that comes with caring for animals, while highlighting the often-overlooked impact of compassion fatigue on veterinary professionals.

1751536.title: Sick & Twisted Tales
1751536.overview: A horror anthology featuring three short stories & a wraparound segment hosted by demented "film critics".

1751600.title: Fúrias
1751600.overview: Porto Alegre innovates once again: it is the first city entirely outsourced to a megacorporation, Fratel. The cutting-edge company's smart management brings technological solutions aimed at bringing more security and efficiency to the city, which serves as a test model for other capitals. Téia and Nanã, however, are left out of all this innovation: elderly, lesbian, and cyclists, they see their freedom and rights increasingly limited by the corporation's interventions. They are left with only two options: adapt or outsmart the system.

1752688.title: Fireweed Blooming
1752688.overview: In a small village far far away lives Ene. Her days pass by cleaning up after her husband and fishing at the pond. On one such day she sees that a local nymph is being abused by her partner. By saving her Ene reflects on her own life.

1756656.title: Blue Hour
1756656.overview: Joey, a student from Yorkshire, keeps his head down and works quietly, more comfortable with tools than with people. The workshop is familiar to him - noisy, practical, predictable. That changes when Skyla, an exchange student from Texas, joins the course. She's open, direct, and out of place in a way that immediately stands out.

1757360.title: Maria of Maria
1757360.overview: Brazil, 1940. Maria, a young outlaw, discovers she is pregnant; after her band is wiped out, she flees to the Center-West to give birth and start life anew. She joins Getúlio Vargas’s "March to the West" government program, which promised land to small farmers. In the first half of the story, Maria confronts untamed nature—discovering that farming is an art. In the second, her past comes back to haunt her, and she must summon her fiercest, most indomitable courage.

1760176.title: Fellas
1760176.overview: Over the course of an app date, Matt tells the story of his "Fellas," and the scandal they get into when a problematic DVD box set goes missing at their housewarming.

1760240.title: 3x4
1760240.overview: Confined to her workplace, a woman laments her friend’s final day on the job. As the farewell draws near, daydreams begin to take over her daily routine.

1762480.title: Fenrir
1762480.overview: A young woman returns to an old holiday home from her childhood, searching for traces of her missing brother.

1762544.title: Holes! The Βallad of Boulder Valley
1762544.overview: Two friends dig holes in a valley in search of a dead man’s treasure. But the hard work never seems to end: the job involves not only digging but burying, too. And Mike is beginning to grow tired.

1766192.title: Insidious Rewind
1766192.overview: Searching for her missing brother, a young woman traces his final signal to an abandoned warehouse, where she discovers a collection of cursed VHS tapes. Captured and forced to watch, she endures four found-footage nightmares that may reveal what happened to him—and what now awaits her.

1766448.title: Amor Moderno
1766448.overview: Based on D. H. Lawrence's short story A Modern Lover. Nabuco comes back after a long absence and finally confesses his love for Mariela.

1767728.title: Poor, poor Timothy
1767728.overview: In a nameless small town, Timothy vanishes during a local festival. One year later, Astride attends the same event with her friends. But suddenly, they disappear as well, and little by little, the entire town seems to empty of its inhabitants.

1767856.title: UNDERGIRL
1767856.overview: UNDERGIRL is a new feature film created by Jun Takahashi and his label UNDERCOVER PRODUCTION, expanding on the brand's 2011 "UNDERMAN" fictional superhero mythology. The film follows Yuri Ibuki, the daughter of the hero UNDERMAN, who must step into her destiny and become UNDERGIRL after her father mysteriously disappears.

1768112.title: Swarm
1768112.overview: Swarm, 2026, McCall’s most recent work, premiering in the exhibition, draws on the rising significance of drones as an increasing presence in daily life. The installation is composed of two conical-light volumes that rotate slowly in opposite directions, one clockwise and the other counterclockwise, over a duration of fifteen minutes. Accompanying the mesmerizing visuals is a rich soundscape that gradually intensifies as a powerful auditory experience. The dramatic, progressive soundtrack serves as a continuation of the ongoing collaboration between McCall and Grubbs.

1768496.title: The Delivery Girl
1768496.overview: A man's mundane life spirals into a nightmare when a food delivery girl develops a deadly obsession with him.
1768496.trailerName: The Delivery Girl | Official Trailer | Tubi Original

1769584.title: The Story of Michael Flagherty
1769584.overview: Sarah and Michael flee into the hills of Connemara and must make a life from the peat, soil and seaweed.

1769648.title: An Impossible Word of Praise
1769648.overview: One day, Gustav hears a rumor that he will be replaced by another butler; the anxiety and uncertainty grow so strong within him that one night he decides to escape.

1771120.title: Chien bleu et autres belles histoires de l'école des loisirs
1771120.original_title: Chien bleu et autres belles histoires de l'école des loisirs

1771376.title: Christmas Angels
1771376.overview: During the Christmas season, an unhoused single mother turns to love, play, and imagination to shield her young daughter from the hardship surrounding them, creating moments of wonder in a world that offers them little.

1778480.title: Starting Towards the Finish Line
1778480.overview: Ever since his mother moved to the city for work, Xiaoqing, who has lost his father, has had a dream: he too wants to go to the Lotus City. After many setbacks, his goal seems out of reach. But when he finds an old, rusty car in the reeds, he finds new hope: will he and his friends make it to the city?
